You can freely download the source code and compile the game here:
https://github.com/Rolandjg/fableflight
The game is fairly performant for how detailed the graphics are, you will need a reasonably powerful GPU though. This is recorded on my RTX 3060.

I have two Claude Plus subscriptions, I was able to build this in a week using Fable 5.2 to solve complex rendering tasks and model the plane. Opus 5.5 was the main workhorse that made the world feel alive.
